question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a red ball, Bob has a white ball, Claire has a orange ball, Dave has a pink ball, Eve has a purple ball, Fred has a brown ball, and Gertrude has a gold ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Alice and Fred swap balls. Then, Fred and Claire swap balls. Then, Fred and Claire swap balls. Then, Dave and Alice swap balls. Then, Dave and Claire swap balls. Then, Eve and Fred swap balls. Finally, Fred and Dave swap balls. At the end of the game, Dave has the
Options:
(A) red ball
(B) white ball
(C) orange ball
(D) pink ball
(E) purple ball
(F) brown ball
(G) gold ball
solution:
Ball colors in order (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude):
Initial: (red, white, orange, pink, purple, brown, gold)
1. Alice and Fred swap: (brown, white, orange, pink, purple, red, gold)
2. Fred and Claire swap: (brown, white, red, pink, purple, orange, gold)
3. Fred and Claire swap again: (brown, white, orange, pink, purple, red, gold)
4. Dave and Alice swap: (pink, white, orange, brown, purple, red, gold)
5. Dave and Claire swap: (pink, white, brown, orange, purple, red, gold)
6. Eve and Fred swap: (pink, white, brown, orange, red, purple, gold)
7. Fred and Dave swap: (pink, white, brown, purple, red, orange, gold)
Dave has the purple ball, option (E).
Final answer: (E)
